reason: A arrives finished and reads as calibrated rather than boosterish: it turns 90 trips into a rate of one every four to five days, says plainly that she has no publications, and limits the thesis claim to what a second season could support. That candour counters my discount for small-college praise. B makes the same points with more generic praise and still has unfilled placeholders (last name, conference, lab, contact details), so it reads as a template.
